Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly identified the star of "Hero and the Terror" as Chuck Norris based on the initial search results, which actually listed Chuck Norris as a supporting actor (Murphy Dunne) and Danny O'Brien as the lead. This data fabrication in step 1 caused the entire reasoning path to fail, as the subsequent search for "Chuck Norris" in Walker, Texas Ranger yielded the wrong character name (Cordell Walker instead of the correct character played by Danny O'Brien).
